title.narrative: Drilling of 15 Deep Wells in the Republic of Sudan

description.narrative: 1) Provide clean and safe drinking water to selected communities in Sudan. 2) Ensure the benefits of the clean and safe drinking water provided.

1) Provision of safe drinking water in Sudan, planned as wells for communities. 2) The well will be open and accessible to all community members and beyond, with a place where livestock can access drinking water.
Intervention in the water and environmental sanitation sector in the Northern State of Sudan through the drilling of 15 water wells.
